pulls/16.title: Repair C4 sanitized nested offline pnpm resolution
pulls/16.body:
Draft review/preparation only. Do not merge, approve deployments, dispatch identity or qualification, publish an immutable successor, or change any live pin/protection/admission. C/C2/C3/C4 and main remain unchanged. No independent-human-review claim.

Exact head: 6e8255949c3da130561f781614785f692796b621

C4 nested pnpm/latest failure reproduced byte-exact. Small production repair allowlists the four fixed prepared-cache/offline Corepack settings; no arbitrary env forwarding or network enablement. C5 production Docker build and six real nested/offline/missing-cache regressions pass. Candidate identity/acceptance suite and candidate/producer typechecks pass; separate producer suite 27/27.

BLOCKER: local PostgreSQL binding replay cannot complete across this runtime internal bridge (TCP SYN timeout); isolated shared network namespace is denied by OCI /proc mount permissions. Failure logs and verified disposable cleanup are preserved. This is not a schema/accounting failure, and no binding/qualification success is claimed. Complete isolated binding replay in a supported disposable environment before any live C5 step.

Repair and candidate PRs are inspection-only against frozen C4; NEVER merge into C4. Producer PR is the separate future main validation source; keep draft and unmerged at this stage. Full local package: docs/governance/drafts/ledgerly-tr01-c5-preparation-identity.json and ledgerly-tr01-c5/ logs/patches.

git/commits/4f0fbd7a4ff75fbc4fadd57bc7ab.message: Prepare separate protected-main producer for exact C5 validation identity

pulls/18/files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,166 @@
+name: TR-01 C5 identity validation
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions: {}
+
+jobs:
+  validate:
+    if: >-
+      github.repository == 'Future00111/ledgerpoint' &&
+      github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
+      github.ref_protected == true
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout exact immutable C5 without persisted credentials
+        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
+        with:
+          ref: 3a5c6e1318b49edcdc7f0f918d3a01813f960e71
+          persist-credentials: false
+          fetch-depth: 0
+      - name: Checkout same-event protected-main producer tests
+        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+          path: .local/tr01-c5-producer
+          persist-credentials: false
+          fetch-depth: 1
+      - name: Validate C5 and run upstream non-database checks
+        env:
+          DOCKER_BUILDKIT: "1"
+          COREPACK_ENABLE_AUTO_PIN: "0"
+          COREPACK_DEFAULT_TO_LATEST: "0"
+        run: |
+          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "3a5c6e1318b49edcdc7f0f918d3a01813f960e71"
+          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^{tree})" = "3f2e22ccceb70ea50034b41af352a125b63cf127"
+          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "6e8255949c3da130561f781614785f692796b621"
+          test "$(git rev-list --parents -n 1 HEAD | wc -w)" -eq 2
+          git diff --quiet
+          git diff --cached --quiet
+          source_pathspecs=(
+            ".dockerignore"
+            ".ci/ledgerly-canonical/Dockerfile.test"
+            ".github"
+            "artifacts"
+            "lib"
+            "scripts"
+            "docs/governance/evidence/ledgerly-44-ti-03-evidence.schema.json"
+            "package.json"
+            "pnpm-lock.yaml"
+            "pnpm-workspace.yaml"
+            "tsconfig.base.json"
+            "tsconfig.json"
+          )
+          test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- "${source_pathspecs[@]}")"
+          corepack enable
+          corepack prepare pnpm@10.26.1 --activate
+          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
+          LEDGERLY_C5_VALIDATION_ROOT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" node --test .local/tr01-c5-producer/scripts/ci/ledgerly-tr01-c5-identity-status.test.mjs
+          node --check scripts/ci/run-ledgerly-canonical-postgresql.mjs
+          node --check artifacts/api-server/scripts/runCanonicalPostingDisposable.mjs
+          pnpm run typecheck:libs
+          pnpm run typecheck
+          node --test scripts/ci/run-ledgerly-canonical-postgresql.test.mjs
+          git diff --quiet
+          git diff --cached --quiet
+          test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- "${source_pathspecs[@]}")"
+          node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
+          import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
+          import { readFile, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
+          import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
+
+          const expectedCommit = "3a5c6e1318b49edcdc7f0f918d3a01813f960e71";
+          const qualificationWorkflow = ".github/workflows/ledgerly-canonical-postgresql.yml";
+          const pathspecs = [
+            ".dockerignore",
+            ".ci/ledgerly-canonical/Dockerfile.test",
+            ".github",
+            "artifacts",
+            "lib",
+            "scripts",
+            "docs/governance/evidence/ledgerly-44-ti-03-evidence.schema.json",
+            "package.json",
+            "pnpm-lock.yaml",
+            "pnpm-workspace.yaml",
+            "tsconfig.base.json",
+            "tsconfig.json",
+          ];
+          const head = execFileSync("git", ["rev-parse", "HEAD"], { encoding: "utf8" }).trim();
+          if (head !== expectedCommit) throw new Error("Offline smoke fixture requires the exact C5 checkout");
+          const files = execFileSync("git", ["ls-files", "-z", "--", ...pathspecs], { encoding: "utf8" })
+            .split("\0").filter(Boolean).sort();
+          for (const required of [
+            ".dockerignore",
+            ".ci/ledgerly-canonical/Dockerfile.test",
+            qualificationWorkflow,
+            "package.json",
+            "pnpm-lock.yaml",
+            "pnpm-workspace.yaml",
+          ]) {
+            if (!files.includes(required)) throw new Error(`Tracked C5 source is missing ${required}`);
+          }
+          const hashes = {};
+          const treeHash = createHash("sha256");
+          for (const file of files) {
+            const bytes = await readFile(file);
+            hashes[file] = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
+            treeHash.update(file);
+            treeHash.update("\0");
+            treeHash.update(bytes);
+            treeHash.update("\0");
+          }
+          const fixture = {
+            fixturePurpose: "offline-build-only",
+            notQualificationEvidence: true,
+            sourceCommit: head,
+            version: 1,
+            files,
+            fileSha256: hashes,
+            sourceTreeSha256: treeHash.digest("hex"),
+            qualificationWorkflow,
+            qualificationWorkflowSha256: hashes[qualificationWorkflow],
+          };
+          await writeFile(
+            ".ci/ledgerly-canonical/source-manifest.json",
+            `${JSON.stringify(fixture)}\n`,
+            { mode: 0o644 },
+          );
+          NODE
+          image="ledgerly-tr01-c5-offline-pnpm-smoke:local"
+          docker build \
+            --file .ci/ledgerly-canonical/Dockerfile.test \
+            --tag "$image" \
+            .
+          LEDGERLY_OFFLINE_PNPM_TEST_IMAGE="$image" \
+            node --test scripts/ci/ledgerly-offline-pnpm.test.mjs
+
+  identity:
+    needs: validate
+    if: >-
+      github.repository == 'Future00111/ledgerpoint' &&
+      github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
+      github.ref_protected == true &&
+      needs.validate.result == 'success'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    environment:
+      name: ledgerly-canonical
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      statuses: write
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout protected-main validation code
+        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - name: Verify exact remote C5 and publish validation status
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+          TR01_VALIDATION_RESULT: ${{ needs.validate.result }}
+          TR01_C5_APPROVED_WORKFLOW_SHA: ${{ vars.TR01_C5_APPROVED_WORKFLOW_SHA }}
+        run: node scripts/ci/ledgerly-tr01-c5-identity-status.mjs
\ No newline at end of file
